abstract: Immunohistochemical staining using the monoclonal antibody of proliferating cell nuclear antigen (PCNA) and argyrophilic nucleolar organizer region associated protein (AgNOR) staining were performed on 28 paraffin-embedded testicular tumors, and their correlation was assessed according to histological type, clinical staging and tumor markers. PCNA positive rates and AgNOR numbers in nuclei were 57.9%, 4.38 in seminomas, 63.4%, 5.79 in embryonal carcinomas, 37.7%, 2.63 in teratomas, 61.3%, 4.43 in yolk sac tumors, 79.5%, 7.12 in choriocarcinomas, and 20.9%, 3.03 in cells of the normal seminiferous tubule, respectively. In pure seminomas, the PCNA positive rates and AgNOR numbers of the stage II to III group (72.6%, 4.75) were higher than those of the stage I group (47.8%, 3.67), but there was no significant difference between the two groups. There was a significant correlation between PCNA positive rate and AgNOR number in all specimens (r = 0.76, p < 0.002). These findings indicate that PCNA and AgNOR are suitable indicators for proliferative activity of testicular tumors.
abstract_ja: 免疫組織化学的染色（モノクローナル抗体によるPCNA染色）およびAgNOR染色を、パラフィン包埋された精巣腫瘍28例について実施し、組織型、臨床病期分類、腫瘍マーカーとの相関を評価した。PCNA陽性率およびAgNOR数は、セミノーマで57.9%、4.38、胎児性癌で63.4%、5.79、奇形腫で37.7%、2.63、卵黄嚢腫瘍で61.3%、4.43、絨毛癌で79.5%、7.12、精細管の正常細胞で20.9%、3.03であった。純粋セミノーマにおいて、病期II〜III群（72.6%、4.75）は病期I群（47.8%、3.67）より高値を示したが、両群間に有意差はなかった。全検体においてPCNA陽性率とAgNOR数の間には有意な相関が認められた（r = 0.76, p < 0.002）。これらの所見から、PCNAとAgNORは精巣腫瘍の増殖活性の指標として適していると考えられる。
